richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Uluberia

c: Uluberia lies on the west bank of the Hooghly in Howrah district, a riverside industrial town with jute and other factories and fast-growing residential areas. The river keeps the air humid, and the monsoon is long. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Uluberia for schools, colleges, municipal parks, factory campuses and residents' associations. Our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, is about 1,610 km away.

We send every order to West Bengal by road, and installation is by our team or a dealer in eastern India. Before that, you share photos, measurements and details of who will use the gym. We suggest machines, mark each station and its clear space on a layout drawing and send a quote. Manufacture starts once you approve.

richText.heading: Riverside humidity and a well-drained base

c: Low ground near the river holds water after heavy rain, so the gym pad should sit above the surrounding level with a drain along one side. Grout every post into concrete so the frames stay firm when the soil is soft. Galvanised pipe and roto-moulded parts handle the damp air.

items.q: How should an outdoor gym be built near the Hooghly?
items.a: On a raised, drained concrete pad with grouted posts. This keeps the machines firm and out of standing water after heavy rain.

items.q: Can factory campuses in Howrah district order an open gym?
items.a: Yes. Many factories place a few machines near the canteen or staff quarters. Share the space and number of workers, and we will suggest a layout and quote.

items.q: Who do we contact for after-sales support?
items.a: Our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or aftersales@funplaysystems.com. They can guide your staff on care and arrange parts when needed.
